title: Simply amazing!
text:
Having been previously on catamaran holidays I wanted to celebrate my 40th Birthday by having a sunset cruise with bbq. 
I have to say that the whole experience was simply amazing with great hospitality from the team and ability to custom make the event! 
Highly recommended!!!
author: darek d

title: A Perfect Day
text: On a recent trip to Barcelona with a big group we wanted to find an extra special experience to enjoy together. Sondevela made for the perfect day from the beginning - Clàudia was so nice and patient with all of our questions about itineraries, prices and dates. The day of, the captain and crew were knowledgeable and more than accommodating. Everything was exactly as advertised (maybe even better!). We didn't do the BBQ option as we wanted to check out the market in the morning and figured we'd pick up some snacks which the crew arranged beautifully for us. We arranged to then get off the boat
author: hawright43

title: Best experience in Barcelona so far!
text: What a unique experience! I am so glad to have chosen the catamaran trip. The view of Barcelona from the sea is awesome and the crew extremely friendly and welcoming, I highly recommend it!
author: traveller9852

title: Nice team!
text:
Super experience! Nice team.
I will recommend this experience to my friends and family members.
I'll book again next year.
author: CoralGadea_J

title: Best experience while in Barcelona!
text:
I visited Barcelona with my girlfriend in September to escape the early Canadian Winter and I can say that without a doubt doing an excursion with Son de vela was the best experience that we had during our time in Barcelona!

From the get go the whole process was seamless! I received a fast reply from the booking team that confirmed my reservation (great English).

When we arrived at the Catamaran we were completely blown away! it seems like the boat is brand new, everything was spotless and there are tons of little details that really make the boat fell very elegant at the same time as homey!
author: Alex V
